composition_question: IS THIS COMMITTED AUTHORIZATION PACKAGE SUFFICIENTLY INSTANTIABLE AND BOUND TO AUTHORIZE A FUTURE REPRESENTATIVE EXPERT-RECOVERY EVENT, WITHOUT AUTHORIZING ITS EXECUTION?
composition_answer: YES. The package is BOUND: every declarative pin recomputes against committed bytes (authorization abbf12bc921c2d28f00a375225b5969145017cfe70da8bfa7486caf502f21c6f, computation contract cd4c52c2b329e397cd491ec23cc355aaae07b7ce2d0116ff86f0ce5dd4b499ad, executor 7831568ffe451ba8b03827a90618514e682ec4a1170882b3bab4acab3d5452ec, rehearsal evidence 8d156da25f32c02de1ec8635edcb0ee0bc3be1baa5f72d5fd256697e39d1650f, reuse contract fb6eb026..., computation source a48b9353..., route evidence 6035308c..., execution evidence dc53b458..., materializer 3c646eba...); the route authority carries the identical eight experts [250,10,237,62,73,177,218,28] with atomic id-weight pairs matching the accepted concrete-route evidence bit-for-bit including the 62/73 rank reversal distinct from the prohibited historical direct-DPREFIX order; the injected input 687a692a... is the attested router_normalized stage hash of the accepted real execution; the 24 retained payloads and 90,439,680 bytes reconcile against the canonical source inventory and IQ2_XXS/IQ3_XXS block arithmetic; the ledger chain closes at authoritative 175 with delta 0; real_event_authorized is false everywhere; the go-token gate binds the exact final authorization file sha by strict dict equality; and execution remains gated on a future single-use release. The package is now also INSTANTIABLE: both cycle-1 required repairs are independently verified in committed bytes. The executor's main() resolves the exact accepted Rust decoder binary (pinned sha 680a6f67..., grounded in the accepted canonical production binding contract) and recomputes both runtime decoder identities against the computation contract authority and all 24 inventory pins BEFORE any mode dispatch, so decoder unavailability or drift now fails closed with zero attempt state (behaviorally demonstrated: --execute with a wrong-identity binary raises RUST_DECODER_BINARY_SHA and creates neither state root nor output root, so the singleton event cannot be consumed by a decoder failure). validate_authorization now hash-enforces the computation contract, the imported strict-f32 computation source, and all four decoder sources at every startup, and requires the HASH_BOUND_LOAD_BEARING_FILES_AND_EXACT_DECODER_BINARY release policy. The committed rehearsal exercises full-geometry synthetic IQ2_XXS and IQ3_XXS dual decode before attempt start; this reviewer replayed the entire rehearsal from committed scripts in a scratch tree (re-pinning only the binary identity to an independently rebuilt binary from the byte-identical pinned decoder sources) and reproduced the committed evidence exactly except the two fields that necessarily encode the binary pin, with the real-geometry dual-decode case hashes byte-identical (152ba99d... = sha256 of 50,331,648 decoded zero bytes, produced through both the Rust binary and the Python spec decoder). The real-decode compute branch was additionally exercised end-to-end over all 24 real-geometry payloads in-process, with decoded_sha256 enforcement and the DECODER_NOT_PREFLIGHTED guard confirmed fail-closed. No blocking or non-blocking-required finding remains; the package authorizes exactly one future representative expert-recovery event and does not authorize its execution.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Accepted Rust decoder binary is a private, non-rebuildable artifact; decoder-dependent evidence is reproducible only by re-pinning
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: The pinned accepted binary sha 680a6f67... originates from the accepted canonical production binding contract (supporting_production_bindings.rust_decoder_binary_sha256) and the computation contract declares rust_binary_private_path_required. A deterministic local rebuild from the byte-identical pinned sources (iq_ref.rs c1606b39..., bridge 31fb0afa...) reproduces sha 6f1ba4c8..., not the pin, so only the privately retained original binary can satisfy resolve_decoder, and the committed rehearsal/preparation decoder attestations can only be regenerated with that binary. This is fail-safe (unavailability now rejects before attempt-start, which was the substantive cycle-1 harm) and this review corroborated the decode behavior byte-identically via a re-pinned scratch replay, but recommend banking the accepted binary bytes in a private artifact manifest alongside the 25 private inputs so future reviews and the release preflight can attest availability directly.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Preparation evidence mutation count is stale
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: The cycle-2 preparation evidence still reports validation.mutation_tests as 26/26 REJECTED while the committed suite now contains 28 mutations (two added in this repair: execution_binding_policy and consumer_authority_requires_terminal_complete). All 28 reject when run at this head, so the claim understates coverage rather than overstating it; correct the counter in the next evidence regeneration.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Executor transitively imports the module containing the sole checkpoint capability class
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: f017_representative_expert_recovery_executor_v1.py imports decoder and kernel symbols from f017_canonical_expert_output_production, whose bytes also define ProductionShardProvider. The executor never references the provider, has no shard path, and the module bytes are now hash-enforced at startup (computation_source_sha256), matching the accepted precedent; noted so the future release review re-confirms the capability remains unreferenced.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Narrow same-machine windows between hash verification and use
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: resolve_decoder re-reads the computation contract from disk after validate_authorization verified its hash, and the Python computation/decoder modules are imported before their source files are hash-verified (a stale __pycache__ entry with matching size/mtime could in principle diverge from the hashed source). Both are single-machine race classes outside the package's threat model and match accepted precedent; closable by passing the verified contract object into resolve_decoder and importing with bytecode caching disabled.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Carried from cycle 1: go-token is synthesizable from committed bytes, not consumed, and one-shot enforcement is path-relative
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: Unchanged posture, by design: the four token fields are derivable from the repository, the token is not invalidated after use, and PRIOR_EVENT_STATE binds to the provided --state-root/--output-root paths. The new execution_binding_policy field commits the future single-use release to hash-bind all load-bearing files and the exact decoder binary; that release cycle (wrapper + release contract + independent approval, binding this cycle's acceptance evidence sha and consuming the token) remains the required next gate before any execution.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Carried from cycle 1, mitigated: reproduction-stage failure leaves banked outputs beside a TERMINAL_FAILURE terminal
defense_in_depth_findings.detail: execute() still writes the eight outputs and manifest before the two fresh-process reproductions, but the output contract now commits consumer_authority_requires_terminal_complete=true, enforced by the validator and mutation suite, so the future weighted-aggregate consumer is contractually bound to terminal.json disposition COMPLETE rather than manifest presence.

cycle_1_finding_disposition.NBR-1: RESOLVED_VERIFIED_INDEPENDENTLY. main() now calls resolve_decoder(document, --decoder-binary) after validate_authorization and before every mode including execute(), so the accepted binary (exact sha 680a6f67..., pinned in the computation contract's runtime_decoder_authority and grounded in the accepted canonical production binding contract) and both recomputed runtime decoder identities (f33641e2... / 76e3d75e..., recomputed by this review from committed source bytes plus the binary pin) are enforced against the contract authority and all 24 retained_payload_inventory pins before any attempt state can exist. Behaviorally verified at the CLI: --execute with a wrong-identity binary fails RUST_DECODER_BINARY_SHA creating neither state root nor output root; a missing binary fails RUST_DECODER_BINARY_UNRESOLVED. --preflight-only now reports both decoder identities in its disposition. The committed rehearsal exercises full-geometry IQ2_XXS and IQ3_XXS dual decode (ordinals 0 and 2, 50,331,648 decoded bytes each, exact byte agreement required) before attempt start; replayed by this review with only the binary pin substituted, reproducing the committed evidence in every other field.
cycle_1_finding_disposition.NBR-2: RESOLVED_VERIFIED_INDEPENDENTLY. validate_authorization now hash-enforces at every startup: the computation contract file against the authorization's pin (COMPUTATION_CONTRACT_SHA), the imported strict-f32 computation source f017_canonical_expert_output_production.py against computation_source_sha256 a48b9353... (COMPUTATION_SOURCE_SHA), and all four decoder sources (iq_ref.rs, f017-canonical-decode.rs, iq2_xxs_dequant.py, iq3_xxs_spec_decoder.py) against decoder_source_bindings (DECODER_SOURCE_SHA); resolve_decoder additionally binds the runtime decoder identities to those source bytes plus the exact binary. future_release_token_requirements now carries execution_binding_policy HASH_BOUND_LOAD_BEARING_FILES_AND_EXACT_DECODER_BINARY, whose presence the executor and validator both require and whose removal the committed mutation suite rejects. Mutation probes of every new enforcement (contract sha, contract path swap, policy removal) reject at the executor level.
cycle_1_finding_disposition.DID-1: RESOLVED. The executor's validate_authorization now itself rejects retry/resume/second_attempt flips (FAILURE_SEMANTICS), all nine prohibition flips including candidate_dispatch and gpu (PROHIBITIONS), and route-pair weight reassignment or binding removal (ID_WEIGHT_PAIR); all probed directly this cycle.
cycle_1_finding_disposition.DID-2: OPEN_BY_DESIGN, strengthened. See C2-DID-5; the single-use release cycle remains future work and is the explicit next gate.
cycle_1_finding_disposition.DID-3: MITIGATED. consumer_authority_requires_terminal_complete=true committed in the output contract, validator-enforced, mutation-tested. See C2-DID-6.
cycle_1_finding_disposition.DID-4: OPEN_ACCEPTED_PRECEDENT. --internal-reproduce remains environment-gated with no durable outputs; now additionally requires the exact pinned decoder binary and the real private inputs.
cycle_1_finding_disposition.DID-5: RESOLVED. Executor load_json now rejects duplicate JSON keys via object_pairs_hook (tested: DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY), aligning with the standalone validator.
cycle_1_finding_disposition.DID-6: RESOLVED. Validator now verifies materializer_sha256 against the committed materializer bytes (MATERIALIZER_SHA), the reuse contract's source_evidence_review_sha256 against the source evidence file (SOURCE_REVIEW_SHA), and the rehearsal's embedded candidate_semantic_sha256 against the document's (REHEARSAL_CANDIDATE).
cycle_1_finding_disposition.DID-7: RESOLVED. The computation contract and authorization now share the single role string CANONICAL_REPRESENTATIVE_POST_ATTENTION_FFN_NORMALIZED_EXPERT_INPUT, and the validator enforces the equality (INPUT_ROLE_VOCABULARY).
